metadata.data_type: synthetic baseline + historically informed synthetic event adjustments
metadata.warning: Planning support only. No landing, aircraft movement, or safety authorization.

model.method: Statistical baseline-profile forecast with historical-event-informed scenario multipliers
model.note: No Random Forest is trained; analyzed baseline averages are used directly. This is a statistical scenario model, not a trained ML model. Model accuracy against actual 2027 arrivals is not available.

assumptions.parking_and_fuel_usage: Disclosed assumptions only; not used by arrival forecast.
assumptions.uplift_source: Research-informed synthetic planning assumptions; see historical_sources.md.
assumptions.rounding: Expected arrivals are allocated to 2-hour intervals using largest remainder, preserving each daily total rounded half-up.

baseline_analysis.description: Analyzed synthetic weekday-by-2-hour averages used directly for forecasting.

research_context.evidence_warning: Historical metro-area ratios are research anchors; weekday-specific multipliers are planning assumptions, not observed traffic at this FBO.
